literal_speaker_lines.speech: Hi fellow, do you need rockits for the upcoming turn of the year? Just let me know if you want to trade.
My name is Ned. Ned Nobel. Maybe you knew my father, his name was Alfred!
I'm an inventor and a salesman. You know, without money no inventions.
He laid the foundation for my invention.
I did plenty of testing and I can proudly say that they are much safer and better now. Nevertheless I can't tell you the formula. It's a secret.
No, I will not tell you and now stop bothering me I have to work.
Tomorrow, I'll return to my secret laboratory and be sure that I won't tell you where that is. I need that privacy to come up with new inventions.
I invented many, many things. It would go too far to explain every single invention to you.
I can offer you rockits to celebrate the upcoming new year! Just ask me for a trade.
Here, take a look. But don't light them here in my pocket! I wish you a Happy New Year!
I wish you a prosperous new year Player!

You freed me... yet my children had to die. It may have been for the better, brave warrior. All around me, I can see them awake. Brothers, sisters, generations. We will not rest, we cannot be stopped. ...
Our will is of iron and stone. Our souls ever dreaming, powerful beyond this world and never to falter. ...
You have to go now, warrior... heed my warning: it's about to begin, this world may yet tremble under the crushing force of other sylvans like me. ...
I found a way to connect, for I was not pure but they merged, I became them, they became... me. You have to go, I will... try to keep, a stand...
Mortal! If you are on a quest to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
To enter the realm of the sanguine master and destroy its spawn, a sufficient sacrifice is imperative. ...
Find and slay the keeper of blooded tears and bring the nectar of his eyes before the blood god. Present your gift on the sacrificial altar. ...
After - and under no circumstances before - you have completed this procedure, you can enter the sacred fluid.
The blood god's power has been corrupted and the spawn that festers in his former realms are a mockery of its grandeur. ...
It has to be exterminated and the realm must be cleansed from the festering presence that came to dwell here!
The leeching corruption is finally stopped and the realm can heal. Perhaps, in a few millennia, the mighty blood god might recover and rise again in new power and sanguine glory! HAHAHAHA!!
The foul thing must fall! Its presence and existence de-sanctifies the holy realm of blood. ...
To be able to challenge that thing, however, you have to handle its spawn. Slay that brood and the way to Bakragore is wide open.

You will have to defeat what calls itself Bakragore at least once to attack the core of its festering presence. You will be able to choose how much of the foul taint of Bakragore and its spawn you can endure. ...
Yet the more taint you put onto you, the harder the battle will become, yet the rewards will be greater.
Though what is left of the powers, granted to me by my god and my extensive knowledge of his essence, I'm able to assist you in managing you the taint, that you obtained and you bear. ...
Mind you though. I can only remove the burden. that you are bearing and once done. You will have to acquire the taints anew.
I can help you with the taint that you wield. You just have to ask.
You are not tainted, mortal.
There is a certain level of reward associated to the amount of taint on you. ...
The areas you will enter, are not what your mortal brain tells you they are. What you experience and see is only what your puny mind can make out of what it cannot hope to fully understand. ...
The true realm is in a flux, all the more after the blood god's demise. They twist and shape themself and become more or less real. ...

By acquiring the taint, you become more .. like the realm themself. And you draw things in, make them real. The more you become tainted and one with the realm, the more likely the unlikely or even formerly impossible becomes real. ...
You will find more .. 'loot' as the likes of you tend to call it. To me it's just a fickle distraction, but to you, I know it's something you strive to acquire.
We all could constantly feel the presence of our god in our very own blood. Then, all of a sudden, his presence ceased to be, the connection was lost. ...

For sure our lord has been slain by envious gods! But blood and slaughter are eternal. There is no end that can't be overcome by universal principle. He who has been slain will rise in slaughter once the time has come! ...
However, first the cleansing of this place has to occur!
The taint of decay will wither and devour any lesser being. But you .. you might prevail.
The scar and void, that the blood gods demise created, still radiated with its divine power. It became an entity of its own. ...
A filthy thing of decay and rot. And it grew in power, unchecked. A malicious evil dwelt in its core, while it roamed the once holy grounds with all of its soiling presence. ...
It shambled and devoured. Its sustenance were the worshippers of the blood god, dead or alive. None of them escaped the hunger. Eventually even the most mighty gave in. ...
The most mighty of all were the dragons, magnificent species of their king. Dragons of might and the olden days. Not the pathetic shadows you know in these days. ...
The thing .. infected them, overtook them, made them his and made them him. ...
At some point, out of a conscious thought or raw instinct, perhaps even a physical necessity the thing gave birth to two sets of twins. ...
Not in any physical sense though. It split aspects of his own, that had befallen some dragons and made them entities of their own. ...
Thus, the twins of rot and the twins of 'the light that is not' came to be.
Your body and your mind are not prepared to receive the blessings of the blood god.
Mortal! If you are on a quest to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
First, you must fight the two pairs of evil twins that lurk in the realm beyond here. ...
Only when you are victorious over all four of them, your path to the source of vileness, the path to Bakragore will be opened. ...
And even this victory will only be the beginning.
Two sets of twins. Two represent the rot that spreads, tarnishes and dissolves. ...
The other pair represent the absence of light, the darkness that devours, the anti-light.
After your first victory, the healing of the place might slowly begin. Yet the wound that is Bakragore will still fester. More victories can weaken the festering even more, yet not without sacrifice.
You will acquire a taint, a certain corruption, a touch of decay when you kill the festering spawn and Bakragore, its source.
The taint of decay will wither and devour any lesser being. But you .. you might prevail.
You can't escape the taint entirely. Yet you can endure it - at a cost.
There are hindrances and weaknesses that come with the taint. ...
You will experience that things won't get as easy as they used to be. Only as long as you are in the contaminated areas, but still.
Please don't keep me from my work.
Shh... I don't really have a job. I need the wood I chop here, though.
Yeah, to be honest, it's not really my wood. It belongs to the queen. But what choice do I have?
Queen Eloise from Carlin likely wouldn't approve. Be so kind to keep this little secret to yourself.
Those bandits have my wife and kids. If I don't bring wood, I don't know what they'll do. Hell, I'd even trade some with you if you had any.
They hide somewhere near the Plains of Havoc. I've never seen their hideout, though, they just send me messages and tell me where to leave the wood.
If you have a piece of wood, I'd give you some money for it. I don't have much, but I'd appreciate your help.
I need all the wood I can get. My hands and my back are already aching from all the chopping. If you have any for trade, let me know.
I don't have anything for sale.
People call me Chip.
Probably better that way.
Why hello Player! I hope you're up to some serious FUN! Oh by the way, I have some news about the contest unless you want to talk about bonus points first!
My name is Friedolin. Fun is what I love and orange what I represent!
I am a fan of Furb of Fun and I'm going to inform other Tibians about the BEST colour to join - orange of course!
He better chose orange!
The wizard contest has begun, join orange if you want to have some fun! Seriously. I can also help you check the status of the contest if you're already a fan!
Furb is the wizard of Fun. Pranks, jokes, funny things - he loves all of it. If you want to have some fun - it's the way to go.
Well orange is my colour! Fun is what I stand for. Orange represents Furb the wizard of fun! Why would anyone choose anything else?
Fern is the wizard of Nature. Behold his powers and the elemental might that is nature itself.
Nature is the element of Fern, the wizard with the green colour. Yeah, never was that much of a nature lover myself but hey.
Feiz is the wizard of Power. Strength, influence and infinite might are his attributes. If you value these attributes, join him.
So far it looks like orange is winning! Violet is next behind!
You can join any wizard by using the powder you can find in the envelope on yourself and the rest on someone who did not already join a wizard and has the right colour. ...
Combining yellow and red will result in orange, yellow and blue will be green and red with blue results in violet.
There are two others like me, some nature freak in Venore and a random girl for violet in Thais. What, do you want to go there? Why? Why would you do that when you could have FUN instead!
The envelopes that came with the creatures contain a magical powder. The three wizards created it to let you represent each of their elements.
The three wizards dropped these envelopes everywhere in the world. A lot of creatures have been carrying envelopes all over Tibia.
You currently have 40 bonus points to spend. Would you like me to explain the bonus point system or do you want to exchange coloured powders?
Alright. Shall I talk about the collecting points or your rewards for exchanging points? Or do you ask yourself why Zaoan chess?
As you know, the three wizards scattered magical envelopes all over Tibia. During this event, a lot of different kinds of monsters will drop those magic envelopes. ...
These envelopes contain coloured powders you can use to colour yourself. Doing this, will yield 10 bonus points for you. ...
You will receive another 10 bonus points if you find another player with the right colour for you to combine with and join one of the three wizards. ...

In addition to the 20 points you can gather by joining a wizard you can collect up to 10 more points by returning any coloured powders you find. I am a fan of the Furb, the orange wizard of Fun and will accept red and yellow powders. ...
The fans of Feiz, the violet wizard of power will accept red and blue powders, Fern of Nature's green fans will accept yellow and blue.
To repay the continuing support of the Tibians, the wizards have created a special version of their favourite game - Zaoan chess. ...
By taking part in the event and with a little luck you will be able to receive a unique set of Zaoan chess figurines, including a unique box for all 32 obsidian and jade pieces. ...
For 5 points you will receive a surprise figurine of a random colour which can be anything, even the queen. ...
For 20 points you will be able to select a figurine of a random colour except the queen. ...
For 60 points you will receive a queen. Guaranteed and on top of that you will be able to choose the colour as well. ...
You will receive the chess box for free from the appropriate fan if you have joined a wizard. Just ask me how to spend your points if you are ready.

Mh, you are not of orange colour. Either you did not join a wizard yet or - the unthinkable - you joined a different colour than orange! You can only claim a reward from me once you have joined the orange wizard.
Well, it's a long story. It has a lot to do with wizardry, a little with chess and quite much with a lady. I know that there must be a book about it, somewhere in a library in Thais.
Since I am a fan of Furb, the wizard of Fun, I will only accept yellow and red powders. Just tell me if you want to exchange your yellow or red powders for bonus points.
It looks like you do not have enough coloured powders with you to exchange. Please return to me with at least 5 powders in your inventory.
There you go, five ( yellow / red ) coloured powders have yielded an additional bonus point! Tell me if you have any more powders to exchange.

You currently have 60 bonus points to spend. Would you like to try your luck for 5 points or select a figurine for 20 points or do you want to exchange 60 points for a queen in the colour of your choice!
I will give you a random figurine of a random colour for 5 bonus points, you alright with that?
Do you want an obsidian queen or a jade queen?
I will give you an ( obsidian / jade ) queen for all your 60 points, is that what you want?
Alright, you still have 60 bonuspoints left to spend.
Looks like you already received your free chessbox. Yes? Oh? Still here? Well, my er... resources... are rather limited. So I can only offer one free chessbox per character, alright? I'm sorry.
I will give you a random figurine of a random colour for 5 bonus points, you alright with that?
There you are, it's ( a / an ) ( obsidian / jade ) ( pawn / rook / bishop / knight / queen )!
Which figurine do you want to receive in exchange for 20 points? A pawn, a rook, a bishop, a knight or a king?
Here you are, ( an / a ) ( obsidian / jade ) ( pawn / rook / bishop / knight / king )!
Alright, you still have 40 bonus points left to spend.
I am sorry but you do not have enough bonus points.
Where did he go? Where did he go?
Goodbye! Oh and - HEY WHAT'S THAT BEHIND YOU?!
Hello and greetings! How I love our meetings!
I'm a jester, I'm a fool. I have no name, though it'd be cool.
To guide you in this challenge I was sent, Kurik asked me to and so I went.
Kurik the genius, Kurik the mad. Is the world hollow or is the world flat?
Down below awaits you a quest. Soon we will learn who is the best.
Go down now and be attentive and quick. With the slow ones kicked out, only the fastest will stick.
Change you will and run around. Find your match or return to the ground.
If you are cunning and act smart, you might be lucky and get a reward.
Since you asked that cute and nice, I offer you this strange device.
You've got your wand. Now leave me be. I say farewell, away with thee.
I'm not yet impressed and just for the rhyme ask me again but another time.
A charming smile and a rhyme on my lips, I'll give the fools a few answers and tips.
The world is full of quarrel, pain and strife. Although not everyone has married my wife.
Though I am famous, I am not here to amuse, I am here to observe and give the curious clues.
Goodbye to you, our meeting was cool. I yet have to guess if you or me is the fool.
Gone without a word and a bye. I have to guess someone is shy.
Greetings, traveller!
I am Domizian.
You might deem me a sage and a scholar.
He is the governor of Edron and grandmaster of the Knights of Banor's Blood. I made his acquaintance some years ago, when he was visiting Darashia.
In case you talk about the werehyaena alpha leader: Her name is Rhargu. She lives deep down in the werehyaena lairs together with her pack.
She's a werehyaena. The leader of the pack that causes so much trouble around Darashia.
Of course, let me see what you have.

So, Daniel Steelsoul sent you? He is a most respectable man and I'm honoured to know him. It is of advantage that you have already dealt with the were-sickness so you won't hurl yourself into this adventure unprepared. ...

Listen, the curse has indeed spread to the Darama Desert - but not recently. It exists here since a long time but only few know about it. Here, it's not werewolves or werebears. The danger that plagues this region are the werehyaenas. ...
Until now they were savage and smelly beasts who hunted down a travelling merchant now and then. But mostly they stayed in their subterranean lairs and lived off carrion. ...

But a few weeks ago something changed. Suddenly they had shamans, something I never saw before. Those shamans are using bone talismans and paint their fur with runes. Runes I saw just once before ... on an artefact from Drefia. ...

I'm afraid the werehyaenas have a kind of pact with the undead of Drefia but I don't have proof. Please go to their lairs and investigate. You will find the entrance north of the town, at a large standing stone. ...
Be careful down there, though! Werehyaenas might not be the only danger you will have to face. I heard strange stories about blood pools, a talking skull and even liches.
So, the werehyaenas are indeed working together with Drefia's undead. That's very dangerous, to say the least. Please, if you can, find a way to stop this.
I guess you need something holy or at least blessed to destroy this evil site. The werelions know a ritual that allows you to bless fire in general. It should work with this torch, too. ...
But you can do that only at a special altar in our sanctum. Go to the Lion's Rock in the north-west of Darashia. Descend to the area where the most noble lions are guarding a secret entrance. ...

There is a door, you can only open if you know the right phrase. It is: 'The sun guides our hearts. The moon guards our dreams'. Down there you will find a room with a mosaic, showing a sun and a moon. ...
There is an altar where you can bless the torch. You have to find a lion mane flower and chop the petals up small. Then sprinkle the chopped petals into the flame while standing at the altar. ...
Thus, the fire will be blessed and should be able to burn down the evil bone shrine.

You destroyed the pact between the werehyaenas and the undead! You did Darashia a great favour, that's for sure. But there are still so many of them, they could be a real threat to the caravans that try to reach the city. ...
Please, kill three hundred of those ferocious werehyaenas and their shamans.
Yes, there are less of them now! What a relief for Darashia. Well, I guess, now I can trust you enough to tell you a little secret about myself. I'm actually a werelion. Don't be scared, though. ...

There's something special to the werelions: We can control the curse and don't attack people like mindless beasts. This is the reason why I can live here in the city and talk to you in such a civilized way. ...

Well, the werehyaenas were a danger to Darashia but they also caused a very personal problem for me. Look, I assumed that they are up to something and that this something could be the undead in Drefia. ...

I warned our king, Heliodor, about it but he didn't believe me. I insisted and got short-tempered - which is never a good idea in the presence of your king. He exiled me as punishment for my impudence. ...

This is the reason why I live here in Darashia. This city has its conveniences but I would like to return to my pride. Please find Heliodor and tell him about the werehyaenas' pact with the undead. ...

Take this ring, it will allow you to enter the lower part of the sanctum. Wear it while you touch one of the lion columns in the centre of the sanctum's upper floor. Then you will reach the lower part.

The werelions are special among the therianthropes. We are not weak-willed victims of the curse. We control it. That means we can change form at will and are not feral beasts as soon as the full moon rises.
Therianthropy is the ability of human beings to metamorphose into other animals. The most well known form of therianthropy is found in stories concerning werewolves. ...
But there are many others, too, like bears, hyaenas or lions.
You found Heliodor and told him about the werehyaenas? He will consider to pardon me? I don't know how I could thank you! Take this as a small compensation for your efforts!
My king will consider to pardon me! Thank you again!
Farewell.
Greetings my friend. It's a relief to see a friendly face in times of trouble.
I was in search of my lost brother. After a long investigation I found most disturbing hints that he amongst others has been abducted for nefarious purposes.
The ruffians that my mercenaries rounded up admitted that they sold their captives to a scientist, that conducts abominable experiments on those captives.
This amoral creature that is known as doctor Marrow has a more than questionable reputation amongst his peers in science.
His disregard of human life and single minded pursuit of his research had him expelled from several institutions despite his scientific genius.
I fear the worst for my dear brother. I beg you to pick up his trail. I've arranged for a passage to the remote island. ...
I plead to you to travel to the island and save my brother from the clutches of doctor Marrow.
A smuggler on Cormaya was the only one, brave enough to set sail to such a remote isle in unknown waters. I will instruct him to ferry you safely to that island. ...
Will you accept this mission? Yes or No?
I can only hope, you will reconsider this. Your reward would be immense.
Thank you so much. I beg you though, please hurry!
We could locate the said island, alas I fear the mission to retrieve my brother safely is beyond the capabilities of the rather unsubtle mercenary company that I have hired.
Of course I will compensate you more than generously, should you return my dear Horan to me. ...
Oh, did I mention, that I already arranged a passage to Marrows Island? Well, all you have to do is to contact the smuggler at Cormaya.
Thank you so much for offering your help.
As you know, I was in search of my lost brother. After a long investigation I found most disturbing hints that he amongst others has been abducted for nefarious purposes.
Good bye!
Hello, brave fighter! What can I do for you? Do you want information, to trade drome points, talk about the old days or take a look at our famous Phants and attires?
Name's Emilio!
We keep a register of every fighter that comes through. If you want to know your personal drome level, starting level or drome points you came to the right place! ...
If you want to know how all this works I have to ask you to refer to the sign over there. I just don't have the time to answer these questions.
Your current drome level is ***.
Your starting level for the current rotation will be ***. Do you want me to lower your starting level by five?
There you go! I lowered your starting level to ***. Do you want to lower it again by five?
I can't lower your level any further!
You accumulated *** drome points.
What do you want to exchange your points for? It's your choice!
They are our pride and joy. Take care of your Phant and it will make for a most trustworthy companion!
You're interested in the Lion of War attire? That would be a well-invested 12500 drome points. Sound good to you?
For 12500 drome points the Lion of War attire could be yours! As of now you amounted *** points.
Well, I guess you'd like to know what I'm still doing here.
I specialised in trading potions in exchange for arena badges. I always liked that job, watching the fights from time to time, helping younger heroes with their first fights. ...
So I kept it. Actually my whole family earned their living this way, you can still meet my brothers and sisters by visiting the other arenas. ...
Maybe you'll even get to know my whole family someday!
In the old arena, if you finished all 10 waves of an arena battle, you'd obtain a fixed amount of arena badges. ...
The exact amount depended on the selected difficulty level. ...
I can check the total amount and offer you potions in exchange for them. Do you want me to hand out your arena badges now?
It looks like you did not earn any arena badges.
Alright, take your time and ask me again once you made up your mind.
As a special service for our most valued customers, we used to hand out a surprise cube. By using it, you'd have a chance of getting nice little goodies.

It's quite easy. I give you arena badges for each arena battle you completed in the past. Surviving 10 waves against monsters in the arena granted you a fixed amount of badges depending on the difficulty level. ...
You can keep the arena badges or exchange them for each kind of health, mana and spirit potions. I'll charge 1 arena badge for the amount of 100 mana or health potions. ...

Emilio: 100 strong potions of either mana or health will be charged with 2, 100 great health potions with 4 and 100 great mana potions with 3, 100 ultimate potions of either type with 7 and 100 supreme potions with 10 arena badges. ....
You can also select 100 great spirit potions for 4 and 100 ultimate spirit potions for 8 arena badges. ...
Would you like to exchange for health, mana or spirit potions now?
Which size are you interested in: regular, strong, great, ultimate or supreme health potions?
Do you want to exchange one arena badge for 100 health potions? Yes or no?
Do you want to exchange two arena badges for 100 strong health potions? Yes or no?
Do you want to exchange four arena badges for 100 great health potions? Yes or no?
Do you want to exchange seven arena badges for 100 ultimate health potions? Yes or no?
Do you want to exchange ten arena badges for 100 supreme health potions? Yes or no?
Which size are you interested in: regular, strong, great or ultimate mana potions?
Do you want to exchange one arena badge for 100 mana potions? Yes or no?
Do you want to exchange two arena badges for 100 strong mana potions? Yes or no?
Do you want to exchange three arena badges for 100 great mana potions? Yes or no?
Do you want to exchange seven arena badges for 100 ultimate mana potions? Yes or no?
Which size are you interested in: great or ultimate spirit potions?
Do you want to exchange four arena badges for 100 great spirit potions? Yes or no?
Do you want to exchange eight arena badges for 100 ultimate spirit potions? Yes or no?
No problem, take your time!
There were 5 difficulty levels when fighting against waves of monsters in the old arena. Each difficulty level granted you a certain amount of arena badges. ...
Level 1 granted one badge, level 2 granted two, level 3 granted three, level 4 granted four and level 5 granted seven arena badges.
Take care and come back soon!
Have fun in the Tibiadrome!
Greetings!
My name is Owin.
Yes, that's my name.
I'm actually a hunter. Or used to be, at any rate. But lately I made some efforts to find out more about the so called Curse of the Full Moon. So I'm also a kind of researcher by now.
It's exactly 3:48 pm.
The savage beasts that frequently threaten Grimvale grow bolder again. With the full moon they may overrun this village.
You should see Maeryn, she may have some errand for you.
She's a close friend and something of a protector for this village. Stunning woman. Fearless and unsurpassed with the bow.
Our village druid still lives here, and has done since she was a little girl. Any were-creature body parts you find, she will trade you for some coin.
The ferryman? Used to be a fisherman. Makes a living by sailing between Grimvale and Edron these days.
This island you are standing on. It used to be such a peaceful and placid place. But now it has become dangerous to live here.
So you don't know it yet. This village and the whole island are affected by were-sickness. We also call it the Curse of the Full Moon.
Humans transform into wild beasts: wolves, boars, bears and others. If you want to know more, feel free to read the parchment here on my cot. I wrote down all my insights.
At full moon humans transform into wild beasts: wolves, boars, bears and others. Some call it the Curse of the Full Moon, others think it is a kind of sickness.

Yes, friend, werewolves indeed dwell here on Grimvale. The were-sickness transforms peaceful villagers into savage beasts. Though we don't know exactly how this curse has come upon us, there's no denying it is here.
The few, mostly abandoned cottages you see here. The village is called Grimvale, as is the island.
There are old legends about a subterranean temple that was once built in this area. I don't know the details, but Maeryn could tell you more, I guess.

It can be assumed that powerful were-creatures should be fought with the help of silvered traps. A common leghold trap can be primed with liquid silver and thus be very effective against were-creatures. I believe Gladys could sell you a trap.
Liquid silver is not easy to be found. But at full moon there are some spots in the tunnels under Grimvale where you could find this rare substance.
I'm sorry, I fear I know nothing about the moonlight crystals. But I heard Maeryn talking about them once. Perhaps she can give you a hint.
Farewell.
Welcome to my little tavern!
Come, take a seat! Or... oh, I see. Feel free to just stand there!
ANOTHER RABBIT, HMPF. OR IS IT A FOX? A BAT?! STAY OUT!
Greetings to you, weary traveller! Do you want something to eat or drink?
My name is of no importance, traveller.
I'm a tavern keeper. I own a tavern. You are standing in it right now. So do you want something to eat, drink or what?
Well, here you go then.
To your health!
It's a fine refuge, don't you think? You can eat, drink and enjoy the relaxed atmosphere to your heart's content!
There are crystals manifold in the hall of refulgence. Yet the eye, the eye of the chasm is the most important - the one important thing. Worth... to me... and me alone, more than anything.
The eye of the chasm. It is the one thing worth anything in this world. It's... it... what do you know about it? No, you don't know anything about the eye! Hmpf!
The king? Er, yes. Our good king. Xenom... he is - oh, I mean he was - a... proud and just ruler. No? Oh, you mean Ti... Tibianus? Of course... yes, very well then.
Don't be... no good can ever come of it.
Edron? Oh this place. Yes, it is a very fine... location. I myself am from Thais, you know. A big metropolis. But it was too busy, too loud. I much prefer the countryside.
Farewell, traveller!
Off you go then!
Oh, hello. You might be one of the talented adventurers we are looking for!
I'm Gnomcruiter.
I'm a recruiter of the gnomish expedition corps.
It's 10:06 pm.
I doubt anything exciting can happen above ground.
It's a very primal area, teeming with life and some of it might even not try to eat you. At some point of the very distant past there must have been a thriving civilisation. ...
Given the fact that many of the local creatures seem to be the forefathers of creatures that we know, we might unearth a connection to known civilisations. ...
Not to mention the abundance of natural resources that we can gather in the area.
I'm looking for talented people to assist our expedition corps.
Are you interested in joining the efforts of the gnomish expedition corps?
You are probably too big anyway.
So listen, our prospectors recently discovered a marvelous new place deep under the surface of the world ...
It is a whole landmass illuminated by a strange mist that hangs over it. ...
It's populated by all kinds of primordeal creatures. ...
Some are probably the progenitors of creatures that we currently know, whereas other creatures have never been seen before. ...
In a joint venture with the adventurers guild we try to unearth the area's treasures and even discovered the remains of a mysterious civilisation that has become extinct long ago. ...
Our greatest accomplishment yet was the discovery of the so called exaltation forge. ...
Our gnomish scientists made the thing work and the adventurers' guild transported it to one of their bases. ...
And we can only guess what other discoveries await us. ...
As of now though, our operation has run into problems. That's where you come into play. ...
We are looking for experienced people that want to join our efforts.

Or the tales of underwater kingdoms ruled by fish-like creatures. Or perhaps the legend surrounding a demonic tree on the Plains of Havoc. ...
Interesting, isn't it? And this is just a taste of what is out there for you to explore.
I do not have a proper name, for I am a child of nature. I was given the gift to communicate with ancient ethereal beings; that is where my name comes from: the 'Spirit Speaker'.

Here's a story worth telling, one that I'm sure will get your attention. There is a legend that says that in the small island of Rookgaard, where new adventurers start their journeys, there is a sword. ...
Guarded by the most powerful of minotaur sorcerers! The sword is known as the Sword of Fury. Is the legend true? Who knows.
There are many treasures out there for adventurers like you to claim, child. If you are brave enough to descend into hell itself! ...
There are many tasks around the world for experienced adventurers like you on the journey to the very Pits of Inferno! But beware! You never know what horrors stand between you and your desires.
WISDOM! Such a desirable thing, isn't it? You have come to the right place, I have much knowledge to share about the world you live in, more than you could ever imagine. ...

But not everyone was born to possess great wisdom, especially when they intend to use it as a tool of destruction. Like Ferumbras for example, who used his immense power to call upon great demons to lay havoc on the city of Thais.
May the spirits guide you.
Be greeted at this forsaken place!
My name is Atui.
I am NOT a Corym, but a human such as you! ...
At least I was, before this madman Marrow turned me into this monster!
It's yet another place that has been tainted by the vile touch of Doctor Marrow!
He somehow fused animals and humans into abominations like me! But I endured. I escaped! And I swore revenge!
I managed to follow Marrow and his new Quara allies to this thing here.
It's a gigantic walking plant that Marrow somehow stumbled upon. While in hiding, I could even hear his nefarious plans!
You see, Marrow and his henchmen are here to harvest a precious resin from the plant. Only the gods know what he might need it for.
Yes, they harvest the resin, which brought them in conflict with some native plant people. Yet while harvesting the resin, Marrow found out a horrible detail.
When they hurt certain plant veins, the giant plant reacts. Now he is misusing this fact, to make it walk towards the mainland.
Marrow figured he'd not only harvest the plant for its resin, he would also use the monster to pay back the society that shunned him and his amoral ideas.
He will use the plant monster as a weapon of mass destruction and to devastate whole cities!
I have no clue what could stop the plant monster from the outside, BUT we can kill Marrow here and now. ...
As soon as they stop harming the plant-thing it will probably get dormant again. So all we have to do, is to fight our way down to Marrow's lair deep down in the plant's stalk.
We better go separate ways. I have my own, stealthy methods. You will somehow have to handle Marrow's minions and the inhabitants of the plant.
There are some native species here. Some sentient plants and the usual giant insects, you know. ...
The plant people are a strange lot, however. They revere the plant as their ancestor and its amber as sacred. I know because I talked to them!
Well they don't talk like we'd do! They somehow communicate directly from mind to mind. This only works for plantlife though, as far as I can tell. ...
By chance, however, I found a way to communicate with them, so to speak.
Stranded here I was kind of desperate for food. I ate anything I could get. It gave me a bad stomach several times, I tell you.
But the worst was the demon root, as I called it!
As soon as you digest it, or rather try to, the thing will burrow its roots into your system! It will give you the headache of a lifetime!
Turned out, that's actually a good thing! That thing seems to be rather symbiotic. As the plant people told me, it will do me no harm.
And after death I'd become the fertiliser for a neat little tree it seems! Not that I'd care when I'm dead. However the thing has a side effect.
Remember those roots, that burrow into your brain? Well they allow the priests of the plant people to communicate with you. If they like to, that is.
Some of them are the only ones willing to interact with us! Without their help you probably won't make it to Marrow's lair.
Yes, they might be of help, but first things first! You'll need a demon root and devour it. ...
Luckily most plant creatures here might carry one around. They are rare but eventually you might loot one of them. Good luck.

The Gingerbread Castle is a magnificent sight to behold. Its cinnamon and clove-scented walls and the sugar-glazed windows can be seen from afar. ...
The castle is guarded by loyal gingerbread men and inside the tasty walls lie rooms with fluffy meringue sofas and cotton candy pillows where the queen resides. ...

Beneath the castle you can find the royal bakery, where truffle confectionists create the finest delicacies. There, you can also visit a well cooled room, where the Great Ice Cream Machine produces Candia's scoops. ...
In a cave underneath the castle you will find the Hot Milk Springs in a chocolate cave, where a bath house was established.

The extensive vaults of the Dessert Dungeon stretch out beneath the Gingerbread Castle. Built partly from gingerbread, partly from waffles and partly from chocolate cake, all three architectural styles of Candia are combined here.
South of the Great Milk Lake, the Peppermint Forest lies waiting patiently for travellers. It consists of tall peppermint trees, reaching out to meet the pale magenta sky. ...
A thick layer of marzipan grass and milk chocolate is surrounding them at the base, often sprinkled with small sugar flowers. ...

Although this forest is beautiful and serene at a glance, it holds some natural hazards and traps, like bubblegum blotches that are littered around the idyllic wilderness. A careless wanderer might get stuck. ...
The biggest of the Lollipop Fields is not far away from here.
While the oceans surrounding Candia consist of blueberry and moon melon lemonade, the lakes and rivers are made of milk and cacao. ...

The Great Milk Lake is the biggest of Candia's lakes and spans a vast region south of the Northern Chocolate Mountains reach. Once a year, the Sugar Plum Fairy hosts a regatta there, and then, dozens of waffle cone boats try to win the prize. ...
In this lake, as well as all other milk and cacao lakes of Candia, you can also fish. If you have a gummy worm or a gummy rotworm as bait, you might catch a taiyaki.
Taiyaki are waffle fish. They are filled with chocolate cream, jam or other sweet stuffings, depending on what they have eaten beforehand.
Dotted around Candia, there are pockets of lollipop groves, glimmering in the sun with an array of bright colours. The shimmering Lollipop Fields seem to change at every new glance. ...
Every trodden path leads to a new discovery: candy floss trees, small waffle and gingerbread houses that are residences for tiny sugar sprites, playing fruit drops or dozing cream blobs.
The Chocolate Mountains consist mainly of dark chocolate, but they possess inclusions of caramel, nuts and cherry sugar. ...

At the lower levels, they are partially overgrown with marzipan grass, but further up, only the pure chocolate peaks rise into the sky. The cherry sugar and the chocolate itself are mined in the underground mines.
The Chocolate Mines are a rich source of sweet, creamy chocolate for us to use in our treats. You can find the entrance in the Western Chocolate Mountains. ...

The mines are a vast area burrowed deep within the ground, full of various chambers and tunnels, each one filled with chocolate in various states of refinement, from raw and untouched to liquid and delicious. ...
The mine is also a chocolate factory, filled with various machines and tools used to refine and shape the chocolate into treats. ...
The busy sugar cube workers take care that everything down there runs smoothly and floating sugar balls pull the sledges on which the chocolate and candy crystals are transported. ...
In some places in the Chocolate Mines you will also find honeycombs that cover parts of the floor and walls. Of course, delicious honey can be extracted from them. ...
But on the other hand, these structures also produce honey elementals, which can become a nuisance for the sugar cube workers in the mines.
There are sugar fairies like me or the gingerbread men, but also the industrious sugar cubes, the cheerful fruit drops, the truffles or the cream blobs. They are all friendly and welcoming. ...
But be careful, down in the Chocolate Mines or in the Dessert Dungeons underneath the Gingerbread Castle, there are also some less pleasant fellows: ...
the candy floss elementals, the goggle cakes or the honey elementals as well as nightmares who came here from Roshamuul, like nibblemaws and candy horrors.
We sugar fairies come in quite a few sizes and shapes. I think, I can say, that we are generally benevolent but prankful, bringing small amounts of delight to those who seek us out. ...
We are typically peaceful, preferring to spread positivity and joy around us. However, there are certain things that can make us angry and upset: ...
rude behaviour, desecration and destruction of sweet creations and delicacies as well as the presence of evil and malicious individuals or forces like Roshamuul nightmares. ...

If we go underground, into the Chocolate Mines or Dessert Dungeons, we are often looking for ingredients or materials to use for our creations, which may be found only in these underground realms. ...

These creations can vary greatly in size and complexity, depending on their purpose and desired effect. Intricate pieces of jewellery, figurines and ornaments are among them as well as colourful dresses and apparel. ...
You search for a chocolate coffee table or a soft peppermint cushion? We craft all of this artfully by hand and some of our creations can be bought at the Candy Carnival.

The sugar cubes are delicate creatures fashioned entirely out of sugar crystals. Some roam carefree across the sweet, colourful surface of our world, but many also work in the underground Chocolate Mines. ...
Industrious but sometimes clumsy, the sugar cubes mine the raw, unrefined chocolate and refine it into creamy, delicious goodness. ...

They mix it with other ingredients, use machinery and tools to shape it, and package it for storage and distribution. The sugar cubes are known for being diligent and hardworking, but often clumsy due to their rectangular shape. ...

Sometimes they fall into milk or cacao lakes and need help getting out. They also can be very talkative and are prone to getting distracted while working. But apart from that, they are the force that keeps Candia's chocolate production going.
They are downright cheerful fellows. When they roam Candia's surface, they like to play hide and seek in the Lollipop Fields or between the peppermint trees. ...
If they work in the Chocolate Mines, they are in charge of adding fruit essences and extracts to the chocolate, to enhance and add flavour to the mix. ...
They are very friendly and sweet - both figuratively and literally, and enjoy working with the different fruits and experimenting with new flavour combinations. ...

They add the special touches to the chocolate, such as fruit peels, extracts, and essences. Fruit drops are creative and innovative, always looking for ways to make the chocolate mixture more delicious and pleasing to the senses. ...
The fruit drops and their mint drop cousins also keep the Big Ice Cream Machine underneath the Gingerbread Castle going.
Among the inhabitants of Candia, the cream blobs are the least busy and prefer to indulge in idleness. ...
They like to wander through the Peppermint Forest or lie on the vanilla sugar beaches at the shores of the Blueberry or Moon Melon Sea. ...
Sometimes, however, they can be persuaded to help the truffles decorate their cakes or donate a portion of cream for the fruit drops who are working with the Ice Cream Machine.
As the name says, gingerbread men are comprised entirely of gingerbread dough, baked and hardened, their limbs and physique crafted to look like a humanoid figure. ...

Their faces, painted with icing, show a cheerful expression and they possess a rather kind and caring disposition. Gingerbread men are crafted and molded out of dough and sugar by truffles who are either bored or lonesome. ...

Then they mould a figure out of gingerbread dough as a friend and playmate. Although the gingerbread men eventually go their own ways and explore Candia, they usually form a lifelong friendship with the truffles that have baked them.

Truffles are small chocolate balls, closely related to sugar cubes and fruit drops. While the sugar cubes are the hard-working miners of the Chocolate Mines and the fruit drops are refiners and decorators, the truffles are born bakers. ...
They transform the mined and partially fruit-flavoured chocolate into sweet pastries such as cakes, biscuits, pralines and so on. ...
They are therefore rarely seen down in the mines, but rather at the ovens in, around and under the Gingerbread Castle. ...
That's where their delicious creations are made. When they are not working, they like to relax in the Hot Milk Springs - but not for too long, so that they don't melt away.
It's a towering monster, standing tall and proud over its surroundings. Its body is made entirely of thick clouds of candy floss, giving it a soft, fluffy appearance. ...

A colourful mixture of sprinkles runs through its sugary limbs. This elemental is rather slow-moving, owing to its soft and fluffy body. Its movement leaves behind sugary, sticky residue that may slow and hinder opponents. ...

It can also suffocate and gum up enemies with its sweet and sugary clouds. Candy floss elementals are rather slow-witted and unambitious, preferring to lay around and take it easy as opposed to actively attacking or seeking trouble. ...

However, if someone invades their territory, they can still react aggressively. Unfortunately this happens quite often, as their clouds of candy floss are delicious to consume and lure unsuspecting foes.

The honey elemental is a creature made entirely of pure and undiluted honey, giving it a sticky and viscous nature. Its body is often moulded into a humanoid shape, though its exact dimensions may vary depending on the amount of honey available.
The goggle cake is a creature made entirely of baked and confectionary goods, such as dough and pastries, with layers upon layers of sweet and deliciously scented fillings and decorations. ...

It is also capable of consuming and absorbing additional baked items, thus enlarging and expanding its body. The goggle cake's appetite appears limitless, as it is always seeking out new food to consume and add to its mass. ...

Goggle cakes are known to possess a sweet and delicious fragrance that can lure in unsuspecting victims. In the process, the savory aromas confuse its opponents' senses. Luckily, it sometimes loses sight of its goal despite its big goggle eyes.

When guzzlemaws or frazzlemaws arrive in Candia, they are transformed into giant balls of peppermint with teeth made of the hardest chocolate imaginable. Their thick sugar coating makes them highly resistant to weapon attacks. ...
This sweet transformation may make them look rather cute, but don't be fooled: They are still dangerous predators who prey on the more peaceful inhabitants of Candia. ..

They seem to particularly like the industrious little sugar cube workers in the Chocolate Mines, so they pose a serious threat to Candia's chocolate supply and are always a thorn in the side of the Sugar Plum Fairy.

If retching horrors get from Roshamuul to Candia, they are changed into candy horrors. Their bulky bodies transform into solid chocolate dough, their spikes into raked cream meringue and candy canes grow where their horns once were. ...
Candy horrors can also tear out these candy canes and throw them at their victims. They don't have to worry about losing them, though, because the candy canes grow back extremely quickly.
Perhaps you are familiar with the acid blob or death blob. But here in Candia you will get to see the chocolate blob, although it is a much more delicious version of its slimy cousins. ...
As the name suggests, it consists entirely of sweet, creamy chocolate. Although the chocolate in Candia melts less quickly than ordinary chocolate, it is not completely impervious to it either. ...
When the summer sun shines particularly strongly on the tops of the Chocolate Mountains, they melt and the liquid chocolate drips down into the marzipan grass. ...
There, chocolate blobs form, which from then on streak across the surface of Candia. However, they are harmless and, unlike other blobs, they do not attack unsuspecting hikers. ...

Sometimes they retreat underground, into the vast Chocolate Mines, where they merge back into the mountains. Others eventually dive down into the cocoa lakes, where they liquefy and enrich these lakes with a fine nutty chocolate flavour.
Sweet dreams!

I have to admit I figured out quite late what is happening. It seems we are both involved in a scheme of it who is known as the snake god rising to power. A process that could mean the end of the world as you know it.
I don't know what it is or was. But I heard that this thing tried to become a god in the past and was trapped in a state 'in between'. ...

Indeed, this will be your task though. Since you cut off the way to control the dragon kings easily, I'll have to put some effort into holding them at bay. ...

We came here from a distant land that is no longer. We took it upon us to become the rulers of this land. We brought order to the struggles and saved a dying empire. ...
We deserve no less than to be accepted as leaders by the lesser beings. We allowed the lizards to exist and to serve us.
They are more familiar to us than the brutish and stupid orcs. In their best moments they are even amusing. All they need is guidance, otherwise they are lost and helpless.
The draken are an exploit of the lizard kin's special breeding procedures. Certain influences under which an egg develops affect several aspects of the creature that is born from it. ...
Gender, intelligence and physique are only a few of them. Special influences create special creatures. ...
An unwanted effect is the birth of the chosen under the influence of heavy doses of undeath. The draken result from exposing lizard eggs to the influence of one of the dragon kings.

They are barely sentient at all. A despicable race beyond all hope. The minotaurs think they have them under control but it is only a matter of time before the orcs will crush them and revert to their old ways.
They were nearly extinct when we arrived. I understand that the minotaurs that pose a problem to us in these days are foreigners in this land. ...
They think they can tame the orcs which I think is such an amusing assumption that I restrained myself from crushing them. ...
I want to watch how they fall flat with this folly. They will fail in the end. It's only a question of how and when.
You are different than the humans here. The humans here are not better than the animals of the mountains and the steppes. ...
You people on the other hand .. well, you might prove a worthy challenge one day. But first and foremost there are other issues to attend which will take a few centuries. ...
Only then I might take a look at your land if I am still interested.
Once the trouble with this mad lizard priest is settled, I have to deal with the problem of the spreading corruption. I am sure I will find a suitable solution. ...
Then the empire has to be restructured and the south to be retaken. After that a phase of rebuilding will begin. ...
The empire lacks manpower and due to the corruption and the loss of land it lacks resources, this is certainly something that needs to be dealt with.
Even we dragons were not unified. We .. continued certain old habits that led to fights which in turn led to inevitable, irreplaceable losses. So by my power I bound the others to my will. ...

Being the eldest and even more powerful than even most of my lesser brethren can imagine, it was my right to do so. In return I taught them to bind the lesser lizards to their will and so we reforged the empire.
I foresaw that with my ultimate demise the infighting would resume and destroy all what is left of us. So I decided that I was too important to die. ...
My time was limited though and the only means of survival that I could come up with was to transform me into a lich, a creature of undeath. ...
It was an .. unexpected experience. However, soon I learnt about the changes my new state of existence involved and the way how things work.

Through my connection to the other dragons, my undeath spread in an unexpected way. And it did not stop at the dragons. It went on through them to the lizards they had bound and through them to the land itself. ...
It seems the land itself became the place where the undeathly influence was finally dumped as it suffered much more than the beings that functioned as transmitters. ...
However, you see that what you call corruption is only an unwanted by-product of something far greater and more important.
It is certainly no ideal state but a necessity. I take it upon me for the sake of the land. Without me my people would perish and so would the civilisation of the lizards. ...
Or worse, they would continue to worship that unspeakable snake thing that is willing to devour the whole world to become a god.

Those fools are misled by the snake god and its treacherous priests. If it weren't for us dragons, the lizards had perished long ago. It was our power that crushed their enemies and our guidance that ended centuries of intrigue and infighting. ...
We deserve their respect and loyalty. They owe us these things like they owe us their existence.
They owe us their existence. Without us their empire would crumble. We are their only hope and the only hope of stability for this land.
If the lizard empire crushed, the orcs would turn on each other and sooner or later wipe out the minotaurs and humans. Then the land would lapse into bloodshed and barbarism. ...
We are the only source of order in this land and the only ones who have the power to enforce such an order.

That is the name of the priest serving this mad snake, isn't it? In the end he is of no importance. He is just a willing vessel. He seems to serve as some sort of anchor or even avatar for the snake's power. ...

Fortunately, his body is too weak to channel much of the snake's power. He might become a formidable opponent but he will still be mortal. With a sizeable force of capable opponents he can be brought down.
The tainted crystals work reversely to their actual intention. It will take a while to reconfigure them. One part of my consciousness is already working on this problem.
The amplified force of the snake god is tearing the land apart. It is using my crystals in a reverse way to drain the vital force from the land and its inhabitants to fuel its power. ...
I will withstand its influence as good as possible and slow this process. You will have to fight its worldly incarnation though. ...

It is still weak and disoriented. You might stand a chance - this is our only chance. I will send you to the point to where the vital force is channelled. I have no idea where that might be though. ...
You will probably have to fight some sort of vessel the snake god uses. Even if you defeat it, it is likely that it only weakens the snake. ...
You might have to fight several incarnations until the snake god is worn out enough. Then use the power of the snake's own sceptre against it. Use it on its corpse to claim your victory. ...
Be prepared for the fight of your life! Are you ready?
We are running short of time foolish mortal. I have no idea how long I can withhold the vital force from the snake god. ...
